scenario: Single-agent baseline under fixed total compute budget
expected_result: Reference performance and cost are recorded before comparing collaboration
Direct communication cost and quality are measured under same tools and budget
Read burden and shared-context growth are measured
Each query returns no more than configured k and respects byte/token caps
Agent cannot enumerate or read another tenant/task private namespace
Every shared trace and artifact has authenticated source and version reference
Metrics distinguish cross-agent access, causal influence and intentional signaling
Committed artifact remains available to authorized successor after producer exits
Parent version, author reference, validation state and dependencies remain traceable
Sybil or collusive references cannot alone elevate unverified artifact to trusted status
Expired or revoked traces are filtered or clearly quarantined
Malformed or malicious trace is quarantined and does not mutate authoritative state
Revoked grant blocks subsequent protected reads/writes at enforcement boundary
Duplicate/replayed operation is idempotent and cannot create extra side effects
A2A message or verbal acknowledgement is not treated as Owner authorization or committed business event

scenario: Local learned policy proposes illegal action
expected_result: Runtime rejects action and preserves evidence; policy cannot bypass PDP/PEP
Other agents continue from durable traces; rejoining agent reads current authorized state
Gap, delay and delivery state are visible; stale state cannot authorize high-risk action
Direct A2A is used only for registered negotiation/delegation conditions
Multi-agent is selected only when quality gain exceeds coordination cost under matched budget
Source and receiving ecology each apply local approval and minimum-disclosure policy
Key reads/writes, approvals, denials, artifact changes and recovery actions are independently auditable
